notes: Shopify store. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (only disallows /pages/configurator). Live main nav/mega menu (checked home.html) currently has no Holiday/Christmas/seasonal entry point (off-season as of Sept 3). Discovered via full sitemap_collections_1.xml (182 collections, single file, no pagination) using search terms christmas/xmas/holiday/festive/halloween/easter/valentine/thanksgiving/diwali/new-year/advent/winter/solstice/seasonal. Found 3 holiday-named collections: the-holiday-collection (parent, 115 products - unambiguously Christmas by content: baubles, ornaments, tree skirts/blankets, advent calendars, tree-top stars, stockings, holiday candles/candleholders - no other holiday mixed in, so normalized to Christmas rather than left generic), holiday-candles (41, exact subset of the-holiday-collection), holiday-decorations (68, exact subset of the-holiday-collection). the-holiday-collection kept as the top-level Christmas grouping row (qty/link null per shared grouping convention) since its 2 named children are genuine subsets; the 9 parent-only items (napkins/table runner/tablecloth/napkin rings/nutcracker) have no dedicated sub-collection on the site so are not broken out further. Excluded: sale-holiday-us (Sale page, excluded per NEVER EXTRACT), decorate-the-holiday-home (0 products; confirmed editorial/lookbook page titled 'Decorate the Holiday Home with Earl of East', brand story content, not a PLP). No Diwali, Halloween, Easter, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, New Year, or Indian-festival categories found anywhere in the collections sitemap or nav.

68 unique product handles via full enumeration: /collections/holiday-decorations/products.json?limit=250 returned all products on a single call (no truncation); cross-checked by counting unique /products/ links across both rendered listing pages (page=1 and page=2, no page=3 link present) - both methods agree at 68.
